    25	    The prompt is transmitted to OpenAI and is never included in errors raised

    38	
    39	    payload = json.dumps({"model": model, "input": prompt}).encode("utf-8")
    40	    request = Request(

    42	        data=payload,
    43	        headers={
    44	            "Authorization": "Bearer " + api_key,
    45	            "Content-Type": "application/json",
    46	        },
    47	        method="POST",
    48	    )
